references.text: Gideon also realizes that he has seen the angel of the Lord after the angel disappears in the flame from the offering, just as Manoah here realizes it after the angel no longer appears.
The angel of the Lord first revealed himself to Manoah's wife, and this verse confirms that it was indeed the angel of the Lord who had appeared to them both.
God tells Moses that no one can see his face and live, which explains why Manoah later fears for his life after realizing it was the angel of the Lord.
Jacob realizes that he has seen God face to face after his struggle with the angel, in the same way that Manoah here realizes whom he has met.
Manoah did not know it was the angel of the Lord when he spoke with him, but now, after the angel no longer appeared, he finally understands who it was.
